title: Add PDF OCR supported pipeline

context.summary: Make scanned-PDF OCR run through @mindory/llm when the OCR role is enabled and persist OCR page artifacts/source refs.
context.background: Native-text PDF extraction already creates page artifacts. OCR capability state was recorded but did not call a concrete adapter.

in: Expose an OCR provider role from @mindory/llm.
Wire the OCR provider into the PDF extractor.
Persist OCR page text as pdf_page artifacts and ocr_text spans with source refs.
Handle disabled, skipped, failed and required OCR states in metadata/errors.
Add integration coverage with a fake local OCR provider and scanned-PDF fixture.
Update docs and validators for the supported PDF OCR path.
out: PDF page rasterization with a native renderer.
Downloading or running heavy OCR model weights.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/llm exposes an OCR provider when OCR is enabled with local-http.
Local HTTP OCR calls POST /ocr and emits operation audit metadata.
Scanned PDFs with no native text can produce OCR page text through the OCR provider.
OCR page text is stored as pdf_page artifacts and ocr_text spans.
Document search can find OCR-derived PDF text with page source refs.
Required OCR failures surface as processing errors; disabled OCR remains non-blocking.

manual_checks: Confirm RAW PDF objects remain immutable and OCR output is derived state.

risks: OCR must not run when the role is disabled.
A failed non-required OCR call must not corrupt native text extraction.
The OCR endpoint contract must stay inside @mindory/llm.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
